India is building futuristic infrastructure that most people have never heard about.
In this video, we explore 10 unusual infrastructure projects in India — including Gati Shakti Cargo Terminals, National Green Hydrogen Mission, Toy Storey Residence in Vadakara, AI-Powered Digital Highways, OTEC & desalination in Kavaratti, CBG and GOBARdhan, Underground Strategic Petroleum Reserves, Pumped Storage Projects, GIFT City Underground Utility Tunnels and GIFT City District Cooling System.
